description: One common scene/task registration that places the unchanged compressed doll proxy at the authoritative retargeting object position. It is identical for Fair-A, Proposed-B, ACT-A40, ACT-B40, and every EVAL10 episode.
orientation_gauge_resolution: The authoritative retarget object was spherical and explicitly left yaw non-gating. The measured compressed oval requires a yaw. Its short axis is aligned to the axial circular mean of the frozen Proposed-B LEFT_GRASP thumb-to-index/middle closing axes across EVAL10 references; no ACT or physics outcome was used.
